changes: Model once and AbortSignal listener removal accurately, warm the non-unloadable p5 module once, and retain a zero per-instance lifecycle delta gate across 20 switches.
Select the most-visible creative host deterministically, re-evaluate ownership with an rAF-throttled scroll handler, and reapply loop state after p5 setup.
Preserve frozen image and gallery aspect ratio before and after media errors.
Remove vulnerable LHCI dependencies and run pinned Lighthouse directly with fail-closed audit aggregation and bounded fixture/Chrome cleanup.
Make public articles crawlable, include snapshot article URLs in sitemap output, precompress public assets, and resolve the trusted local P5 host only after client runtime enablement.
Keep reading progress and the share control in SSR markup so hydration changes state without inserting layout boxes; add no-JS footprint and hydration CLS regression coverage.
